title: Missing or untraceable source evidence
when: Candidate has no supporting excerpts or citations do not support the claim.
procedure: Request retrievable evidence; never invent a source or treat absence as contradiction.

title: Missing observable symptom details
when: Lesion shape, location, distribution or progression is not described or visible.
procedure: Ask one discriminating observation or request an image of the relevant part.

title: Insufficient distinction between supported alternatives
when: Several source-supported diseases fit and the distinguishing feature is missing.
procedure: Identify the specific distinguishing feature, using only supplied sources.

title: Missing environmental exposure or temporal coverage
when: Station samples do not cover the cited infection window, duration or growth-stage anchor.
procedure: Separate station overlap from sustained wetness; ask for relevant anchors only. Optional missing weather need not block a tentative symptom hypothesis. Do not request already supplied context or irrelevant growth-stage anchors. Missing proof of infection does not automatically block a tentative symptom hypothesis.

title: Material conflicting evidence
when: Supplied source claims disagree, or a candidate claim contradicts evidence for that same candidate.
procedure: Cite both sides, describe the actual disagreement and request a resolving observation/source. Do not confuse an alternative disease with a contradiction.

title: Mismatched scope or provenance
when: Evidence concerns another crop, organism, location or measurement type.
procedure: Identify the mismatched scope. Do not transfer foreign occurrence or canopy conditions to this case.

title: Conclusion exceeds available evidence
when: The claim asserts confirmed infection, a probability or treatment/regulatory status unsupported by the supplied facts.
procedure: Revise the wording to a tentative hypothesis or withhold the unsupported claim.

title: Adequately supported tentative hypothesis
when: Observations and sources support the stated tentative claim and remaining unknowns are limitations.
procedure: Return no manufactured blocking issue; retain specific limitations and allow the Judge to decide.
